name: Time After Time
description: Livia and Felipe are in a forbidden love story doomed to end tragically. A century later, they both have a new chance to make their love real again. “Time After Time” is an innovative romance set in two different eras in which characters hold the opportunity to make up for their mistakes, come to terms with the past and write themselves another story.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Emília is hiding a secret and decides to send Lívia to a convent. Melissa only thinks about her marriage to Felipe. Everyone prepares for the Countess's arrival. Felipe prevents a tragedy.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Felipe finds one of Lívia's books and decides to return it. The Countess tells Gema that she had a reason to return to Campobello. Lívia thinks about Felipe. Zilda fires Raul.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Emília and the Countess confront each other. Lívia doesn't want to take her vows at the convent. Bento reunites with the Countess. Raul receives a proposal from Emília. Felipe goes to the convent looking for Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: The Countess's dinner begins. Bianca is charmed by Felipe. Emilia confronts the Countess and the two exchange threats. Rita and Lívia escape from the convent.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Pedro gets jealous when he sees Lívia and Felipe talking and lies. Felipe confesses his feelings to Lívia. Melissa arrives in Campobello. Emília reveals her secret to Gema.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Emília demands that Lívia be transferred to another city. Melissa makes plans to get rid of Alex. Rita gets a new job. Pedro goes to the convent and declares his love for Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Ariel saves Emilia. Livia sees Melissa and Felipe together. Rita and Felicia have fun together. Anita writes a note to Livia.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Lívia decides to return to Campobello. Salomé wants Bianca to win Felipe over. Afonso declares his love for Anita. Felipe surprises Melissa with a proposal.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: Afonso asks Vitória for a chance. Lívia doesn't want to return to the convent. Vitória approves of Felipe planting on her land. Lívia and Felipe exchange glances.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Emilia's health worsens. Dorotéia warns Melissa about their financial situation. Zilda catches Afonso with Anita. A secret is revealed. Ariel accumulates lies.

videos.title: Chapter 11
videos.overview: Bento delivers important news to the Countess. Zilda threatens Anita. Pedro offers support to Lívia. Afonso is shocked by an order from his mother. Felipe can't stop thinking about Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 12
videos.overview: Lívia and Emília tell Father Luís the truth. Melissa is rude to Carola. Felipe meets Lívia and declares his love for her. Lívia visits her father's grave.

videos.title: Chapter 13
videos.overview: Lívia notices someone watching her in the woods and runs away. Salomé and Bianca get nervous around Melissa and Doroteia. Count Felipe thinks about Lívia. Gema makes a proposal to Raul.

videos.title: Chapter 14
videos.overview: Severa sabotages Rosa and Anita's recipe. Lívia tells Anita a secret. Count Felipe realizes that Countess Vitória is hiding something. Count Felipe is honest with Melissa.

videos.title: Chapter 15
videos.overview: Melissa despairs when she realizes that Felipe is unwilling to change his mind about the breakup and asks Countess Vitória for help. The news spreads. Felipe goes to the convent.

videos.title: Chapter 16
videos.overview: Lívia arranges a meeting with Count Felipe. Afonso almost kisses Anita, but they are caught by Bento. Pedro demands that his mother get rid of Raul, but Gema argues with him.

videos.title: Chapter 17
videos.overview: Emília tells Lívia that she agrees to leave with her. Anita sees Melissa leaving Count Felipe's room wearing only a nightgown. Countess Vitória pressures Felipe about the engagement.

videos.title: Chapter 18
videos.overview: Lívia is devastated by what Anita tells her and begs Father Luís for help. Countess Vitória assures Melissa that Felipe will change his mind. Melissa manipulates Anita.

videos.title: Chapter 19
videos.overview: Emília assures Lívia and Gema that Bernardo is alive. Countess Vitória decides to call Raul back. Pedro argues with Raul. Melissa discovers that Felipe is in love with someone else.

videos.title: Chapter 20
videos.overview: Raul tells Gema about his decision. Melissa makes a scene with Felipe and then tells Countess Vitória everything. Bento grabs Rosa and threatens her. Felipe surprises Lívia in the forest.

videos.title: Chapter 21
videos.overview: Count Felipe is cold towards Lívia, but she asks for help. Melissa gets closer and closer to Alex. Bento grabs Anita and Afonso catches them in the act. Lívia is surprised at the convent door.

videos.title: Chapter 22
videos.overview: A spark ignites between Gema and Raul. Lívia tells Gema that she thinks her father might be alive. Afonso seeks out the Countess to report the harassment and is punished. Bento kidnaps Chico.

videos.title: Chapter 23
videos.overview: Bento abandons Chico in the rain. Raul looks for his son in despair. Felipe visits Massimo and Salomé gets everything wrong. Melissa makes a request to Countess Vitória and is humiliated.

videos.title: Chapter 24
videos.overview: Count Felipe tells Roberto about the breakup of the engagement. Lívia goes to talk to the priest and he reprimands her. Bento threatens Chico. Lívia shows the cross to Emília, her mother.

videos.title: Chapter 25
videos.overview: Lívia tells Emília about the cross. Anita is charmed by Roberto. Felipe sees Lívia at the convent gate while riding a horse. Roberto is charmed by Lívia and tries to get closer to her.

videos.title: Chapter 26
videos.overview: Melissa tells Conde that Lívia will fall for Roberto's smooth talk. Emília breaks Bernardo's tombstone. Roberto asks Conde Felipe to reconsider ending their engagement.

videos.title: Chapter 27
videos.overview: Countess humiliates Zilda. Emilia opens Bernardo's coffin. Roberto decides to go after Lívia. Melissa confesses to using Alex. Count Felipe finds Lívia at the store.

videos.title: Chapter 28
videos.overview: Count Felipe and Lívia have a disagreement. Sister Lucia questions Lívia and Emília about why they haven't left. Roberto goes to the convent looking for Lívia. Countess Vitória plans to leave Campo Belo.

videos.title: Chapter 29
videos.overview: Pedro threatens Chico. Felipe invites Afonso to help with the business. Felícia and Rita go to the mansion to tell the Countess about her son. The Countess goes to her son's grave.

videos.title: Chapter 30
videos.overview: Count Felipe meets Countess Vitória and Zilda in the woods. Lívia questions why the Countess lied. Bento reconstructs the tomb at the Countess's request.

videos.title: Chapter 31
videos.overview: Lívia decides to confront Vitória about her father's whereabouts. Vitória is shocked by the news about Bento. Lívia bids farewell to the convent. Felipe questions Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 32
videos.overview: Lívia asks Felipe to disappear from her life. Bento begins the search for Bernardo. Lívia shocks Father Luiz with a request. Bernardo appears in the vicinity of the mansion.

videos.title: Chapter 33
videos.overview: Ariel protects Bernardo. Vitória communicates her wishes to her family. Lívia is suspicious of Vitória's plans. Alex cheers Melissa up with the news. Pedro meets Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 34
videos.overview: Lívia gets a job at Countess Vitória's mansion and leaves Emília disappointed. Melissa discovers Felipe's plans. Rosa provokes Zilda. Felipe finds Lívia in the mansion.

videos.title: Chapter 35
videos.overview: Felipe is shocked to find Lívia in the mansion. Felipe and Roberto exchange provocations. Doroteia discovers Vitoria's plans. Melissa has an unexpected encounter at the mansion.

videos.title: Chapter 36
videos.overview: Doroteia talks to Bento about Bernardo's death. Pedro provokes Felipe by kissing Lívia. Emília receives a mysterious visitor. Vitória finds Lívia in her room.

videos.title: Chapter 37
videos.overview: Lívia manages to mislead Countess Vitória. Melissa schemes to get closer to Felipe. Ariel tries to convince Emília to forgive Lívia. Roberto makes a revelation to Countess Vitória.

videos.title: Chapter 38
videos.overview: Melissa and Doroteia plot against Felipe. Father Luís is astonished to find Lívia. Vitória admires Melissa's honesty. Felipe surprises Melissa during dinner.

videos.title: Chapter 39
videos.overview: Melissa questions Doroteia about the visit to Bernardo's grave. Lívia is upset about Felipe and Melissa's wedding. Raul declares his love for Gema. Vitória feels unwell.

videos.title: Chapter 40
videos.overview: Lívia manages to balance Countess Vitória's situation. Countess Vitória hires Lívia to be her lady-in-waiting. Emília has an emotional encounter.

videos.title: Chapter 41
videos.overview: Countess Vitória thanks Lívia for her gestures. Emília takes care of her beloved after their reunion. Rosa despairs about the baby's future. Melissa tries to sound out Anita.

videos.title: Chapter 42
videos.overview: Roberto tries to court Bianca. Countess Vitória catches Lívia admiring Bernardo's portrait. Bento seduces Doroteia. Emília despairs over Bernardo's disappearance.

videos.title: Chapter 43
videos.overview: Countess Vitória asks Felipe and Melissa to set a wedding date. Bernardo remembers the accident. Felipe defends Livia from Roberto's advances. Bento captures Bernardo.

videos.title: Chapter 44
videos.overview: Livia and Felipe go to the shack in search of Bernardo. Melissa teases Felipe about Livia and Felipe's disappearance during the afternoon. Bento informs Countess Vitória about Bernardo's capture.

videos.title: Chapter 45
videos.overview: Countess Vitória travels to the abandoned shack to find Bernardo. Livia discovers Pedro's true nature. Ariel prepares to intervene in Bernardo's life and prevent further suffering.

videos.title: Chapter 46
videos.overview: Countess Vitória doesn't find Bernardo at the abandoned shack. Doroteia discovers Countess Vitória's secret. Felipe discovers Livia's lie and confronts her upon his return to the mansion.

videos.title: Chapter 47
videos.overview: Felipe confronts Lívia's lie and threatens to tell Countess Vitória. Bernardo remembers Emília again. Felipe finds out about Countess Vitória's escape the previous night.

videos.title: Chapter 48
videos.overview: Felipe demands an explanation from Countess Vitória about his nighttime escape. Melissa suspects a relationship between Lívia and Felipe. Pedro searches the secret passages for Bernardo.

videos.title: Chapter 49
videos.overview: Felipe rescues Lívia from the river after an accident. Melissa plots against Countess Vitória. Pedro is consumed by jealousy over Lívia's affair. Rita confronts Pérsio.

videos.title: Chapter 50
videos.overview: Melissa confronts Lívia. Roberto spends the night with Anita and takes her to a bar. Bento shows up at Gema's house. Alex finds a photo of his deceased mother.

videos.title: Chapter 51
videos.overview: Severa makes a discovery about Alex's mother. Countess Vitória asks Lívia to live in the mansion. Emília is worried about Lívia. Severa makes a revelation to Felipe.

videos.title: Chapter 52
videos.overview: Felipe hesitates to believe Severa's story. Lívia discovers that the Countess's medication has been tampered with. Melissa tries to intimidate Severa and makes a discovery.

videos.title: Chapter 53
videos.overview: Felipe is pensive about Berenice's death. Lívia finds a birthmark on Countess Vitória. Felipe leaves Melissa distressed with questions.

videos.title: Chapter 54
videos.overview: Melissa tries to avoid Felipe's questions. Melissa provokes Lívia. Bento becomes suspicious when he sees Rosa. Felipe tries to get closer to Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 55
videos.overview: Felipe and Lívia almost kiss, and Melissa watches the moment hidden. Bento threatens to tell Countess Vitória the truth about Rosa. Ariel looks for Emília to find Bernardo.

videos.title: Chapter 56
videos.overview: Pedro threatens to tell the truth about Lívia if they don't get married. Bento insinuates telling Countess Vitória that Rosa has a son. Gema tells Lívia that Emília found Bernardo.

videos.title: Chapter 57
videos.overview: Lívia is thrilled to meet Bernardo. Emília expels Lívia because she decides to continue her work at the mansion. Melissa seeks information about Berenice's diary with Severa.

videos.title: Chapter 58
videos.overview: Alex hides Berenice's diary. Roberto proposes to Bianca, and Anita finds out. Bento invades Rosa's room and tries to force her to sleep with him.

videos.title: Chapter 59
videos.overview: Countess Vitória throws Bento out after he harasses her. Roberto and Bianca get engaged, and Massimo suspects his future son-in-law's intentions. Bento reveals Raul and Gema's relationship to Pedro.

videos.title: Chapter 60
videos.overview: Anita suspects she might be pregnant with Roberto's child. Pedro discovers that Bernardo has been found and that Lívia already knew. Rita returns to work at Felícia's house.

videos.title: Chapter 61
videos.overview: Bento reveals Countess Vitória's secret to Dorotéia. Ariel takes Bernardo to the mansion as a way to make amends for his mistakes. Countess Vitória urges Lívia to travel with Felipe.

videos.title: Chapter 62
videos.overview: Emília discovers that Lívia and Rafael traveled together. Anita faints after suspecting she is pregnant. Pedro is outraged when he confirms the relationship between Raul and Gema.

videos.title: Chapter 63
videos.overview: Livia and Felipe spend the night in the shack during a storm. Raul is reported and arrested for assault. Pedro confronts Livia and Felipe upon their return from the trip and threatens to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Chapter 64
videos.overview: Pedro tells Felipe that Lívia is lying. Anita confirms her pregnancy. Lívia resigns and Countess Vitória falls ill. Pedro tells Melissa that Lívia and Felipe spent the night together.

videos.title: Chapter 65
videos.overview: Gema confronts Pedro for reporting Raul. Pedro allies himself with Bento. Felipe manages to free Raul at the police station. Melissa corners Lívia for a conversation with Felipe about the trip.

videos.title: Chapter 66
videos.overview: Melissa and Lívia clash. Anita tells Roberto she's pregnant. Raul decides to leave Campobello with Chico. Lívia and Emília have an emotional reunion.

videos.title: Chapter 67
videos.overview: Dorotéia pressures Anita to give the baby up for adoption. Pedro and Bento team up to arrest Bernardo. Lívia confesses that her father is hiding at Gema's house.

videos.title: Chapter 68
videos.overview: Pedro's henchmen attack Raul. Zilda tells Bento that she saw Bernardo in the garden. Roberto feigns interest in Anita so as not to interfere with Melissa's wedding.

videos.title: Chapter 69
videos.overview: While fleeing to the mansion disoriented, Bernardo is spotted by Zilda. Countess Vitória reveals to Lívia that her son is alive and lost in Campobello.

videos.title: Chapter 70
videos.overview: Melissa plots for Roberto to deceive Anita. Emilia seeks shelter for herself and Bernardo at the convent. Pedro tries to seduce Carola. Afonso discovers that Anita is pregnant.

videos.title: Chapter 71
videos.overview: Roberto kisses Bianca at the picnic. Lívia tells Emília about Countess Vitória's plans to have Bernardo committed when she finds him. Melissa distracts Severa, and Alex has a horse riding accident.

videos.title: Chapter 72
videos.overview: After Alex's accident, Severa is dismissed and Lívia takes over as the boy's tutor. Afonso attacks Roberto upon discovering Anita's pregnancy. Felipe and Lívia kiss again.

videos.title: Chapter 73
videos.overview: Pedro joins Bento in the hunt for Bernardo. Felícia disappears at night. Carola leaves the mansion door open at night for Pedro to enter, and he goes to Lívia's room to deliver information.

videos.title: Chapter 74
videos.overview: Pedro reveals Bento's plan to Lívia. Massimo discovers that Roberto tried to open his safe. Anita ends her relationship with Roberto. Dorotéia blackmails Countess Vitória with her secret.

videos.title: Chapter 75
videos.overview: When Countess Vitória is blackmailed by Dorotéia, she becomes ill. Bernardo flees the convent disoriented. Afonso asks Anita to marry him. Bento finds Bernardo in the woods.

videos.title: Chapter 76
videos.overview: Dorotéia tries to bribe Afonso into marrying Anita. Zilda hears Anita confess Afonso's pregnancy and intentions to the priest. Countess Vitória has an emotional reunion.

videos.title: Chapter 77
videos.overview: Massimo sees Roberto trying to open his safe. Countess Vitória tells Lívia that she found her son again and the lady reacts with revolt, raising Felipe's suspicions.

videos.title: Chapter 78
videos.overview: Bento takes Bernardo to Emilia's grave at Countess Vitória's request. Anita tells Roberto that she will marry Afonso. Troubled, Lívia reveals to Felipe that she is Bernardo's daughter.

videos.title: Chapter 79
videos.overview: Lívia tells Felipe that Bernardo is alive and that she is his daughter. Anita accepts Afonso's marriage proposal. Felipe finds the hideout where Bento hid Bernardo.

videos.title: Chapter 80
videos.overview: Felipe finds Bernardo and they run away from Bento. Pedro discovers that Anita is pregnant. Raul helps Felipe hide Bernardo in the mansion. Felipe declares his love for Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 81
videos.overview: Melissa hatches a plan to force Felipe to marry her. Afonso announces that he will marry Anita. Dorotéia steals a love letter from Countess Vitória's room.

videos.title: Chapter 82
videos.overview: After Melissa's plan succeeds, Felipe is forced to marry her. Anita suffers an accident following a fight between Pedro and Roberto. Dorotéia discovers a new secret of the countess.

videos.title: Chapter 83
videos.overview: Felipe tells Lívia that he will ask for an annulment of the marriage. Alex tells Severa that he has Berenice's diary and gives it to Felipe, who discovers Melissa's lies.

videos.title: Chapter 84
videos.overview: Felipe and Lívia run away from the wedding. Dorotéia blackmails Countess Vitória. Bento tells the countess that Felipe was the one who took Bernardo. Massimo breaks off Bianca and Roberto's engagement.

videos.title: Chapter 85
videos.overview: Countess Vitória shoots Bernardo, mistaking him for Bento. Roberto reveals to Melissa and Dorotéia that he managed to steal Massimo's gold bars. Emília goes to the mansion.

videos.title: Chapter 86
videos.overview: Countess Vitória learns that Emília is alive. Pedro and Melissa join forces to seek revenge against Lívia. Countess Vitória makes a discovery about Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 87
videos.overview: Felipe and Lívia are victims of Melissa and Pedro's hatred. 150 years later, the couple reunites in Rio de Janeiro. The second phase begins.

videos.title: Chapter 88
videos.overview: Lívia, an oenologist, is enchanted by Campobello wine without knowing it belongs to Felipe, a winemaker in Belarrosa. Lívia goes to Belarrosa to buy the winery from Vitória Ventura.

videos.title: Chapter 89
videos.overview: Afonso is charmed by Anita when he shows her and Lívia the winery. Emília plots something against Vitória. Lívia decides to stay for the town festival, where she reunites with Felipe.

videos.title: Chapter 90
videos.overview: While dancing together at the party, Lívia and Felipe have the feeling that they already know each other. Emília is delighted to see Bernardo's photo in a book. Afonso helps Vitória with the sale of the winery.

videos.title: Chapter 91
videos.overview: Pedro displays excessive jealousy towards Lívia. Emília insists on signing the winery purchase contract in person in Belarrosa. Vitória is humiliated at a family lunch.

videos.title: Chapter 92
videos.overview: Emília, Anita, and Lívia go to Belarrosa to negotiate a winery deal. During a visit to the Campobello vineyard, Lívia sees Felipe harvesting. Emília goes to Vitória's house and isn't recognized.

videos.title: Chapter 93
videos.overview: In conversation with Alberto, Emília reveals her interest in getting revenge on Vitória. Severa and Melissa have a heated argument in the studio. Lívia and Felipe reminisce about a moment from the past.

videos.title: Chapter 94
videos.overview: Lívia runs away from Felipe after a kiss. Ariel gives Gema and Emília a push to rekindle their friendship. Pedro shows up at Lívia's hotel in Belarrosa.

videos.title: Chapter 95
videos.overview: Melissa quits her job at Zilda's atelier. Emília plots a way to humiliate Vitória. Lívia meets Felipe at a winery and discovers he owns Campobello.

videos.title: Chapter 96
videos.overview: Felipe complains about Dorotéia's neglect of Alex. Emília expresses interest in buying the Campobello Winery. Felipe seeks out Lívia for a conversation.

videos.title: Chapter 97
videos.overview: Emília recalls childhood memories with Vitória. Bento and Mássimo argue over Rosa. Emília questions Dorotéia to find out if the Campobello Winery is for sale.

videos.title: Chapter 98
videos.overview: Felipe rejects Emília's offer to buy Campobello. Bento is fired by Massimo after a fight. Anita and Afonso go out on a date.

videos.title: Chapter 99
videos.overview: Anita and Afonso kiss. On her daughter's birthday, Vitória sees her photo and expresses her longing. Vitória receives a legal notice in Emília's name and will need to leave the house.

videos.title: Chapter 100
videos.overview: Chico runs away from home after hearing that Queiroz wants to send him to an orphanage. Emília rejoices at Vitória's despair upon learning of the eviction. Lívia is struck by Felipe's car on the road.

videos.title: Chapter 101
videos.overview: Felipe and Lívia kiss again. Bernardo and Raul find Chico in the woods. Vitória kicks Lívia out of her house, thinking she is siding with Emília.

videos.title: Chapter 102
videos.overview: Gema and Raul meet for the first time. Vitória says she will not leave her home. Gema threatens to divorce Queiroz. Felipe arranges to meet Lívia, and Dorotéia tells Melissa.

videos.title: Chapter 103
videos.overview: Emília and Bernardo meet. Dorotéia sees an unhappy fate for Melissa in the cards. Melissa shows Felipe a recording of her argument with Severa and turns him against his sister.

videos.title: Chapter 104
videos.overview: Lívia discovers that Emília will not sell the house and has kicked Vitória out. Pedro goes to Belarrosa to visit Lívia and decides to set a wedding date. Vitória goes to live with Zilda.

videos.title: Chapter 105
videos.overview: Bento asks Vitória for forgiveness. Queiroz is uncomfortable with Raul's presence in his house. Bento is arrested after refusing to leave the Ventura's old house and attacks Emília.

videos.title: Chapter 106
videos.overview: Vitória discovers that Bento has been arrested and Luís manages to release him. Rita meets Felicia. Felipe goes to Lívia's room when he finds out that she is sick and is attended to by Pedro.

videos.title: Chapter 107
videos.overview: Anita pretends to be involved with Felipe to spare Lívia from Pedro's jealousy. Bernardo reveals the real reason he went to Belarrosa. Lívia takes a stand with Pedro.

videos.title: Chapter 108
videos.overview: Pedro begs Lívia not to break off the engagement. Bento forcibly kisses Rosa and is thrown out. Pedro pressures Anita to reveal whether Lívia is in love with another man.

videos.title: Chapter 109
videos.overview: Vitória is hired by Rosa to work at her restaurant. Mateus has a vision of Gema's past life. Vitória calls Alberto.

videos.title: Chapter 110
videos.overview: Alberto lies to Vitória about Emília. Bernardo goes to the orphanage where he was adopted to seek information about his origins. Vitória starts working at Rosa's restaurant.

videos.title: Chapter 111
videos.overview: Alberto lies to Emília about Vitória. Queiroz finds a drawing by Mateus and confronts Gema and Raul. Pedro misunderstands an interaction between Lívia and Afonso.

videos.title: Chapter 112
videos.overview: Melissa forbids Severa from getting close to Alex. Bento blackmails Luís using love letters exchanged with Vitória. Pedro attacks Afonso, suspecting he is having an affair with Lívia.

videos.title: Chapter 113
videos.overview: Pedro lies and tells Lívia that Afonso provoked him. Bernardo makes progress in his search for information about his biological family. Pedro tells Melissa that Felipe is having an affair.

videos.title: Chapter 114
videos.overview: Melissa barges into the Beraldini meeting to confront Lívia and Anita. Roberto asks to be the father of Anita's child. Bernardo asks Emília out on a date.

videos.title: Chapter 115
videos.overview: Vitória asks Bento to stop blackmailing Luís. After meeting Roberto, Anita and Afonso kiss. Alberto feels ill and Emília has to rush to Italy.

videos.title: Chapter 116
videos.overview: Zilda takes Gema to visit a friend who is knowledgeable about spirituality. Bento is arrested for racial slurs against Raul. Lívia tells Felipe she is going to end her engagement to Pedro.

videos.title: Chapter 117
videos.overview: Severa threatens to expose Melissa's betrayal. Luís hires a lawyer for Bento as a condition for getting the letters back. Bernardo tells Vitória about Bento's arrest for racial slurs.

videos.title: Chapter 118
videos.overview: Rita, Felícia, and Rita hatch a plan to make Massimo fall in love with Salomé. Felipe turns down a romantic trip with Melissa. Mateus confronts Queiroz about his behavior toward Raul.

videos.title: Chapter 119
videos.overview: Alice asks Rosa to let Bento live with them so that he can be released. Felipe tells Lívia that he is going to ask for a divorce. Melissa reveals to Felipe that she is pregnant again.

videos.title: Chapter 120
videos.overview: Dorotéia devises a plan to obtain Lívia's DNA for a test. Mateus shows no interest in honing his spiritual gift. Felipe asks Melissa to take a pregnancy test.

videos.title: Chapter 121
videos.overview: Severa is outraged upon learning of Melissa's pregnancy. Alberto asks Emília to take him to Brazil to see Vitória before he dies. Melissa receives her pregnancy test results.

videos.title: Chapter 122
videos.overview: Melissa's pregnancy test comes back positive. Carola overhears Lívia talking about Felipe but lies to Pedro. Felipe tells Melissa he will divorce her regardless of the pregnancy.

videos.title: Chapter 123
videos.overview: Melissa threatens Felipe. Pedro blackmails Carola into revealing Lívia's secrets. Vitória prepares a memorial mass for the anniversary of her daughter's death.

videos.title: Chapter 124
videos.overview: Lívia ends her engagement to Pedro. Melissa asks Lívia to stay away from Felipe. Bento asks Raul for forgiveness for racist insults. Gema asks Queiroz for a separation.

videos.title: Chapter 125
videos.overview: Melissa tells Pedro that Lívia and Felipe are together. Vitória questions Luís's lies regarding Bernardo's biological family. Bianca and Pérsio go public with their relationship.

videos.title: Chapter 126
videos.overview: Smitten, Felipe and Lívia spend the night together. Rosa invites Anita to be the musical act at the osteria. Melissa lies to Alex about her separation from Felipe.

videos.title: Chapter 127
videos.overview: Anita finds herself torn between Afonso and Roberto. Vitória holds a memorial mass marking the anniversary of her daughter's death. Emília targets Zilda to intensify her revenge against Vitória.

videos.title: Chapter 128
videos.overview: Zilda and Vitória reconcile. Pedro hatches a plan to get Anita fired. Melissa runs off to Rio de Janeiro with Alex, leaving Felipe and his family in despair.

videos.title: Chapter 129
videos.overview: Bernardo reveals to Emília that Vitória's daughter died. Gema tells Raul about the separation. Felipe discovers that Melissa fled with Alex to Rio de Janeiro.

videos.title: Chapter 130
videos.overview: Bento returns to playing the piano at the osteria. Ariel reveals his growing feelings for Rosa to Mestre. In Rio de Janeiro, Felipe finds Alex and Melissa at a hotel after they run away.

videos.title: Chapter 131
videos.overview: Emília asks Pedro for help in plotting against Felipe and Vitória. Pedro plans a trip for Alberto to Belarrosa. Bernardo makes a discovery about his biological father.

videos.title: Chapter 132
videos.overview: Bernardo tells Vitória that Guilhermo is his father. Felipe tells Melissa he will fight for custody of Alex. Emília arranges to meet Luís to talk about the Venturas.

videos.title: Chapter 133
videos.overview: Felipe is worried about overdue mortgage payments. Emília fears the winery sale could be annulled if Bernardo turns out to be a Ventura. Rosa is growing fond of Bento again.

videos.title: Chapter 134
videos.overview: Vitória confronts Luís for hiding Guilhermo's illegitimate son. Bernardo asks Bento for help with a paternity test. Melissa loses the baby and doesn't tell Felipe.

videos.title: Chapter 135
videos.overview: Emília plans to sabotage the payment to the Campobello winery in order to buy Felipe's house at auction. Bento refuses Bernardo's request to take a DNA test. Alberto arrives in Brazil.

videos.title: Chapter 136
videos.overview: Bento goes missing, worrying Rosa and Alice. Emília scolds Lívia for taking Alberto to Belarrosa. Lívia overhears a revealing conversation between Emília and Alberto.

videos.title: Chapter 137
videos.overview: Lívia makes a discovery about Vitória. Luís reveals an important secret to Vitória regarding Guilhermo's inheritance. A master helps Bento unlock childhood memories.

videos.title: Chapter 138
videos.overview: Bento frees himself from guilt over his mother's death. Lívia reveals a desire to hear Vitória's side of the story. Bento decides to take a DNA test with Bernardo.

videos.overview: Lívia visits Vitória to find out her side of the story. Bernardo and Bento take a DNA test. The City Hall delays payment for Felipe, who fears losing his mortgaged house.

videos.overview: Lívia tells Emília and Alberto that she talked to Vitória. Mateus has visions of Rosa and Vitória’s past lives. Felipe makes a shocking discovery about Melissa.

videos.title: Chapter 141
videos.overview: Rafael confronts Melissa's lie. Queiroz plans to send Chico to an orphanage. Melissa tells Alex that she lost the baby because of Lívia. Alberto asks Lívia to take him to Vitória.

videos.overview: Pedro takes revenge on Anita by sabotaging her work at Beraldini. Melissa decides to confirm Alex's paternity to hurt Felipe. Ariel takes Alberto to see Vitória.

videos.title: Chapter 143
videos.overview: Alberto tells Vitória that Emília is alive. Melissa quarrels with Alex after the boy says he enjoyed meeting Lívia. Bernardo and Bento find out the DNA test results.

videos.overview: During a heated argument, Emília makes an unexpected revelation to Vitória. Alberto is taken to the hospital after being found unconscious. Melissa forces her way into Lívia's car and threatens her.

videos.overview: Pedro tells Carola that Emília is going to acquire the mortgaged houses belonging to Felipe and Zilda. Pedro and Melissa plot against Lívia and Felipe. Vitória leaves Bernardo distraught with a revelation.

videos.overview: Emília reveals her past to Bernardo. Afonso asks Berenice to be his girlfriend. Lívia discovers Emília's plan to buy up Felipe and Zilda's houses and confronts her. Vitória visits Alberto.

videos.overview: Vitória tries to prove to Emília that Alberto lied. Bento seeks redemption with the people he hurt. Upon discovering Emília's plans against Vitória and Felipe, Lívia resigns from Beraldini.

videos.overview: When threatened by Pedro, Carola turns the tables. Anita and Carola plan to rent a house in Belarrosa together. Alberto wakes up in the hospital and hesitates to tell Emília the truth.

videos.title: Chapter 150
videos.overview: Carola reveals a secret from the past to Emilia. Massimo proposes to Rosa, but she refuses. Melissa crashes a dinner at Zilda's house and makes a shocking revelation to Felipe.

videos.title: Chapter 151
videos.overview: Melissa says she will take a test to confirm who Alex's father is. Emilia reveals she had prior knowledge of the existence of a lost heir. Queiroz reports Gema to Child Protective Services.

videos.title: Chapter 152
videos.overview: Felipe confronts Roberto about his betrayal. Anita decides not to have a baby with Roberto. Lívia questions Alberto's lies and asks him to tell Emília the truth.

videos.title: Chapter 153
videos.overview: Anita discovers that Afonso is dating Berenice. Felipe hands over evidence of Melissa's instability to the lawyer. Alberto tells Emília the truth.

videos.title: Chapter 154
videos.overview: Emília is devastated when she learns the truth. Dorotéia tells Melissa that she took a DNA test to find out if her daughter is Lívia's sister. Emília is involved in a serious car accident.

videos.title: Chapter 155
videos.overview: Lívia finds Emília's overturned car, and Emília is taken to the hospital. Juvenile authorities go to Gema's house and take Chico to an orphanage. Vitória discovers secrets shared by Luís and Emília.

videos.title: Chapter 156
videos.overview: Gema gets emotional about Chico's departure. Melissa shuts off the winery's cellar at Vinícola Campobello to spoil the wines. Vitória confronts Luís about his lies and his deal with Emília.

videos.title: Chapter 157
videos.overview: Roberto decides to take a DNA test to confirm Alex's paternity. Lívia tells Alberto that Emília is hospitalized. Gema and Raul obtain custody of Chico and adopt Clara.

videos.title: Chapter 158
videos.overview: Vitória reunites with Alberto. Lívia temporarily takes over management of Beraldini, and Pedro is outraged. Roberto receives the results of his DNA test.
